unresolved_items: TLC-UB-LDA-118: noise state space — The state space and type compatibility of X_n + epsilon_n are not specified.
TLC-UB-LDA-119: Sigma covariance — Numeric covariance, dimension and units of Sigma are absent.
TLC-UB-LDA-120: Gaussian process/sampler — The distribution declaration does not prescribe a sampler, seed or stochastic process.
TLC-UB-LDA-121: noise independence — Temporal or inter-dimensional independence is not stated and must not be inferred.
required_behavior: Preserve X_{n+1}=X_n+epsilon_n and epsilon_n~N(0,Sigma) as explicit source-backed relations while leaving numeric covariance and sampling process unspecified.
forbidden_behavior: Do not invent covariance values, temporal/dimensional independence, seeds, samplers, or a simulation process.
